claims.text: Mastitis is diagnosed by history and examination; tell it apart from engorgement without inflammation or infection.
claims.quote: Diagnosis of mastitis is by history and physical examination. Mastitis must be differentiated from breast engorgement without inflammation or infection.
Breast abscesses are diagnosed by ultrasound and are treated mainly with drainage via needle aspiration or surgical incision.

claims.text: Not improving on antibiotics and no abscess: milk culture.
claims.quote: In rare situations when there is no abscess and the patient is not improving with antibiotics, milk culture can be done.
